study: F3 WP3.2 slice S1: the lunar solid tide as an opt-in production force term (REQ-DYN-007, DYN-06)
written: 2026-11-08, before any WP3.2 code, test or number. Read before writing: the dynamics.py propagation paths, propagation_contract.py, gravity_harmonics.py, the GL1800F / GRGM1200L / GRGM660PRIM labels (python_port/data/gravity, read only), the WP3.1 study term (studies/phase17/scripts/wp3_1_force_terms.py, phase_c7_dynamics_candidates.py) and tests/test_f1_srp_variational_gradient.py (the oracle precedent). No propagation, test or timing was run
base: branch f3/wp3-2-force-terms from f3/wp3-1-materiality 206cb69 (stacked on PR #115, whose decisions set this scope)
scope_decision: WP3.1-R decision 2026-11-08 (the owner delegated it to the agent; survey report section 9): the tide goes in as an opt-in term and defaults and frozen results stay unchanged. WP3.2 slices: S1 TIDE, S2 LRP, S3 EARTH_SHADOW, S4 SRP_LIGHT_TIME (one package), S5 hold-out replication and REQ-DYN-007 closure, each with its own predeclaration
question: Does the production propagator, with the opt-in tide, integrate the term WP3.1 found material, with a variational gradient that matches it, without changing any existing default path?

physics.model: elastic (frequency-independent, no lag) solid tide of the Moon raised by B in {Earth, Sun}, degrees n in {2, 3}: V = sum k_n GM_B R^(2n+1) / (d_B^(n+1) r^(n+1)) P_n(c), c = r_hat . d_hat; a = grad V = A r^-(n+2) [-(n+1) P_n r_hat + P_n'(c) q], q = d_hat - c r_hat, A = k_n GM_B R^(2n+1) / d_B^(n+1)
physics.gradient: G = A r^-(n+3) [(n+1)(n+2) P_n r_hat r_hat^T - (n+2) P_n' (q r_hat^T + r_hat q^T) + P_n'' q q^T - ((n+1) P_n + c P_n') (I - r_hat r_hat^T)]; symmetric by construction, traceless by the Legendre equation (V is a solid harmonic)
physics.parameters: GL1800F label (jggrx_1800f_sha.lbl): k2 = 0.024223, k3 = 0.0163, R_ref = 1738.0 km, and 'The second and third degree gravity coefficients of this model do not include the permanent tide', so a GL1800F user adds the full tide
physics.frame: none needed: an elastic tide is axially symmetric about the raising body's direction, so the term is evaluated in the propagation axes from the Moon-centred Earth and Sun positions the third-body terms already use
physics.no_indirect_term: the Moon's own deformation exerts no net force on the Moon's centre of mass; the reaction of the Earth on the lunar bulge acts on the lunar orbit and is in the planetary ephemeris
physics.tide_system: the static field must exclude the permanent tide (tide-free). Only GL1800F's label says so. The GRGM660PRIM and GRGM1200L labels in the repository are silent, and the production default J2 constant (2.0346e-4 at 1737.4 km, 'IAU/GRAIL') has no stated tide system. For the Moon the Earth-raised tide is mostly permanent (synchronous rotation): its permanent degree-2 zonal part is about 4e-4 of J2 (back-of-envelope, to be computed in the report). Pairing the full tide with a field that already contains the permanent part would double count a part comparable to the term itself. DYN-04 found the default (J2, R) pair 4.7e-4 above GRGM1200A's in J2 R^2; whether that difference is the permanent tide is not established

design.module: new src/lunar_od/lunar_tide.py: GL1800F constants with provenance; frozen keyword-only LunarTideOptions(static_field_convention (required, no default), love_numbers=((2, k2), (3, k3)), radius_m=1738.0e3, raising_bodies=('EARTH', 'SUN'), provenance); tide_acceleration(r_sc, r_earth, r_sun, mu_earth, mu_sun, options) -> (3,); tide_gravity_gradient(same arguments) -> (3, 3). Complex-step safe: norms are square roots of dot products and the input dtype is preserved
design.convention_guard: static_field_convention = 'TIDE_FREE' is the only accepted value. 'ZERO_TIDE' and 'MEAN_TIDE' raise, because removing the permanent part needs a conventional permanent tide for the Moon that this slice does not define. Any other value raises
design.validation: love_numbers non-empty, degrees in {2, 3} without duplicates, values finite and > 0; radius finite and > 0; raising_bodies a non-empty, duplicate-free subset of {'EARTH', 'SUN'}; at propagation, a raising body whose GM passed to the propagator is not > 0 raises (the tide would otherwise vanish silently); a lunar_tide that is neither None nor a LunarTideOptions raises TypeError
design.dynamics: dynamics._with_tide_acceleration(rhs, get_earth_pos, get_sun_pos, mu_earth, mu_sun, tide, *, state_size) returns rhs ITSELF when tide is None, the SRP wrapper's identity contract. It adds a_tide to elements 3:6. For state_size 42 it also adds G_tide @ Phi[0:3, :] to rows 3:6 of Phi_dot, and for 48 it also adds G_tide @ s_K[0:3] to s_K_dot[3:6]. The 6-state path never evaluates the gradient. With the tide on, the Earth and Sun lookups are cached per epoch (as _share_sun_lookup does for SRP), so the force model and the tide share one lookup per epoch; with the tide off no cache is added
design.keywords: lunar_tide=None (keyword-only, appended last) on propagate_state, shadow_contact_times, propagate_augmented_state (the plain and the harmonic path), propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, propagate_truth_with_ephemeris, and the internal _build_state_rhs and _propagate_augmented_with_harmonics. The D2 contact pre-pass integrates the same tide-on 6-state RHS, so its cuts and the final trajectory agree
design.transport_S1b: propagation_contract.model_options and propagator_options(srp, propagation_profile, lunar_tide=None). The key 'lunar_tide' appears only when a LunarTideOptions is given, so every historical options dict is unchanged. The 15 estimators.py functions that carry propagation_profile gain lunar_tide=None and forward it to every propagation: nominal, candidate, posterior, Jacobian and K sensitivity
design.deferred: UKF, EKF and the fast sigma propagator (make_fast_sigma_propagator), scenarios, scenario_config, the CLI, the desktop app, observability, numerical_metadata and the force contract do not get the parameter in S1. None of them can enable the tide (fail closed by absence). They join with the scenario-level transport after S4

gates.T_G1_DEFAULT_IDENTITY: (a) _with_tide_acceleration(rhs, ..., None, state_size=k) is rhs (object identity) for k in {6, 42, 48}. (b) A fixed configuration set gives byte-identical outputs (SHA-256 of the array bytes) before the change (this tree, run twice before dynamics.py is edited, to show run-to-run determinism) and after it, both with lunar_tide omitted and with lunar_tide=None. The set covers: 6-, 42- and 48-state; ADAMS and DOP853; the numba and reference paths; SRP off, CONICAL_PENUMBRA and NO_SHADOW; shadow events on and off; Moon J2 and Earth J2; a zonal harmonic model with harmonic_stm_opt_in; shadow_contact_times; propagate_truth_with_ephemeris; estimate_position_bls_lm, estimate_position_srif, estimate_range_rate_bls_lm and estimate_range_rate_srif
gates.T_G2_IERS_ORACLE: Independent route: the IERS 2010 eq. 6.6 coefficients dC_nm - i dS_nm = (k_n / (2n+1)) (GM_B / GM_M) (R / d_B)^(n+1) Pbar_nm(sin phi_B) exp(-i m lambda_B), with fully normalised Pbar_nm from closed forms written in the test. They are loaded into a SphericalHarmonicGravityModel and evaluated by production gravity_harmonics.spherical_harmonic_acceleration and spherical_harmonic_gravity_gradient in a random body-fixed frame (a random rotation, the raising body's coordinates taken in that frame). Samples: 200, seed 20261108; spacecraft radius uniform in [R_MOON + 20 km, R_MOON + 3000 km]; Earth distance in [356 000, 407 000] km; Sun distance in [0.983, 1.017] AU; isotropic directions. Per body and degree: |a_closed - a_SH| <= 1e-12 A r^-(n+2) and ||G_closed - G_SH||_F <= 1e-12 A r^-(n+3). The four-term sums equal tide_acceleration and tide_gravity_gradient to the same tolerance
gates.T_G3_STUDY_PARITY: on the T_G2 samples, lunar_tide.tide_acceleration with the default GL1800F options equals the WP3.1 study term wp3_1_force_terms.tide_acceleration (the term WP3.1 found material) to 1e-13 relative
gates.T_G4_GRADIENT: on the T_G2 samples, per body and degree and in total: the analytic gradient equals the complex-step Jacobian (h = 1e-30 m) of the production tide_acceleration to 1e-13 relative (Frobenius); G == G^T exactly; |trace G| <= 1e-12 ||G||_F
gates.T_G5_VARIATIONAL: Geometry: synthetic moving Earth and Sun (circular, sidereal month and year, 23.44 deg tilt), 100 km circular polar orbit, Moon J2 on, a 6 h arc sampled every 300 s, production propagators at DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14. Oracle: fixed-step RK4 (5 s) re-propagation of the PRODUCTION tide-on 6-state RHS (dynamics._build_state_rhs), central differences with h = 1 m and 1e-3 m/s; the step sequence is identical, so there is no adaptive-step noise (the F1 pattern). (a) SRP off: max over columns j of max|FD_j - Phi e_j| / max|Phi e_j| <= 1e-7. Negative control, an analysis-only replica with the tide in the trajectory and no tide gradient in the variational block: its error >= 10 x the gated error. (b) SRP NO_SHADOW, K = 0.01 m^2/kg, dK = 1e-3: max|FD_K - s_K| / max|s_K| <= 1e-6. (c) RHS structure, no integration, at random states: the tide-on minus tide-off RHS equals [0, a_tide] in 0:6, G_tide @ Phi[0:3, :] in rows 3:6 of Phi_dot and G_tide @ s_K[0:3] in s_K_dot[3:6], each to 4 eps of the base element magnitude, and nothing else moves; the 6-state path never calls the gradient
gates.T_G6_PATH_CONSISTENCY: T_G5 geometry with SRP NO_SHADOW K = 0.01 and the tide on. Positions from the 6-state, 42-state (numba and reference) and 48-state propagations agree to 1e-5 m. Phi from the 42-state (numba and reference) and 48-state runs agree to 1e-8 of max|Phi| (F1 precedent). A zonal synthetic harmonic model (Cbar20 and Cbar30; j2_moon = 0; MOON_PA_DE440 label; constant rotation; harmonic_stm_opt_in) gives the same agreement between its 6-, 42- and 48-state paths
gates.T_G7_SHADOW_EVENTS: 1 day on the T_G5 orbit with the Sun in its plane (eclipses every orbit), SRP CONICAL_PENUMBRA K = 0.01, shadow_events True, DOP853 at the production rtol 1e-11 and atol 1e-12. (a) The 6-, 42- and 48-state propagations with the tide complete, and the contact check passes at every cut. (b) The tide moves at least one cut by more than _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S (1e-3 s) from the tide-free cuts. (c) Negative control: segmenting the tide-on RHS at the tide-free cuts raises the contact-consistency RuntimeError
gates.T_G8_FAIL_CLOSED: each validation in design.validation and design.convention_guard raises: static_field_convention missing, None, 'ZERO_TIDE', 'MEAN_TIDE' or unknown; degree 4; a duplicate degree; k <= 0 or non-finite; radius <= 0; an unknown or duplicate body; empty tuples; a lunar_tide that is not LunarTideOptions; the GM of a raising body 0 at propagation
gates.T_G9_REGRESSION: full pytest: 0 failures, 0 errors, skips unchanged apart from the new tests' own; tools/check_repository.py passes; the protected-file re-freeze is additive (a new table first in expected_current_tree_sha256, history unchanged, the history chain in tests/test_f1_srp_variational_gradient.py extended)
gates.B_G1_OPTIONS: without lunar_tide, model_options and propagator_options return dicts equal to the historical ones for srp in {None, enabled, disabled} x profile in {None, PropagationProfile(), PropagationProfile('ADAMS', False)}. With a LunarTideOptions they additionally hold exactly that object under 'lunar_tide' and nothing else changes. A value that is not LunarTideOptions raises TypeError
gates.B_G2_TRANSPORT: spy on every propagation entry point estimators.py calls. For each of the six public estimators (position, range-rate and two-way range, each with BLS-LM and SRIF), with return_posterior where offered: every captured call carries a lunar_tide identical to the given object, and with lunar_tide omitted no captured call has the key
gates.B_G3_RECOVERY: noiseless position observations every 300 s on the T_G5 6 h arc, with truth from propagate_state with the tide (DOP853, rtol 1e-12, atol 1e-13). estimate_position_bls_lm and estimate_position_srif with the tide and PropagationProfile(), started 100 m and 0.1 m/s off: |dr0| < 1e-3 m and |dv0| < 1e-6 m/s. Contrast: the same solve without the tide has |dr0| >= 100 x the tide-on value

expectations: stated before the run, not gates: T_G2 and T_G4 near 1e-15; T_G5(a) gated error ~1e-9..1e-8, with the control ~1e-6..1e-5 (the tide gradient is ~1e-6 of the central gradient at 100 km); tide-on and tide-off trajectories differ by metres in 6 h and by tens of metres in a day (WP3.1: 86.6 m in its worst cell); the Python wrapper costs about as much per RHS call as the SRP wrapper
out_of_scope: the frequency-dependent and dissipative (lagged, Q ~ 40) tide and order-dependent k2m (GRGM660PRIM's k20, k21 and k22 differ by up to 4 %): not modelled, bounded in S5's error budget. Removing the permanent tide for a zero-tide or mean-tide field. The loader half of DYN-06: the repository's fields are PDS SHADR files whose tide system is free label text, so a parsed tide_system field would protect none of them. The tide in UKF, EKF, fast sigma, scenario, config, CLI, desktop, observability, numerical metadata and the force contract (design.deferred)
reject_if: if any gate fails, S1 is reported as computed and not offered for merge until a fix passes a gate set recorded in docs/assurance/amendment-log.md; a change to a gate after its result is exploratory (amendment log)
agent_decisions: agent decisions under the owner's 2026-11-08 delegation, flagged for review: (1) a wrapper architecture (additive, identity when off) instead of threading the term through f3body_moon and dynamics_jacobian_a_matrix; (2) a required static_field_convention with only TIDE_FREE accepted; (3) GL1800F's elastic k2 and k3 as the only parameter set; (4) the deferral list; (5) the protected-file re-freeze of dynamics.py, estimators.py and, if protected, propagation_contract.py under the scope decision; (6) the branch stacked on #115
